explanation: The theorem characterizes membership in the weight-space-one subcomodule of Hom(V,W) for a normal Hopf ideal. It says the map commutes with the base-changed comodule action at the quotient point. I searched Mathlib for endOfPoint, weightSpace and HopfIdeal. The only hit was Mathlib/RingTheory/HopfAlgebra/Quotient.lean, which defines Ideal.IsHopfIdeal and the quotient Hopf algebra. It has nothing about normal Hopf ideals, weight spaces of comodules or equivariant Hom.
